caption: A new account starts with 100 free credits, and we were not asked for a card. The account name is hidden.

For our two address test list the free analysis already predicts a 100% bounce rate, and checking both addresses costs 2 credits. The extras Company Enrichment and Email Engagement Insights are not ticked.
The check marked both addresses undeliverable and none risky, and the balance dropped from 100 to 98 credits.
The download keeps all columns from the original file and adds the result columns; both boxes are ticked by default.
When the free credits run out, the smallest pay as you go purchase is 1,000 credits at $0.008 per email, so $8.00.
